fields.summary: Event not emitted when no user agent is provided

renderedFields.description:
From https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo/issues/2255

When a HTTP PATCH request occurs and there is no User-Agent provided, Fedora will process the update but fail to emit a STOMP message indicating that the update had occurred:
